description.content: Send, resend, retrieve, list, and download faxes.

Sends a fax to one or more recipients. Documents may be supplied as file attachments (multipart/form-data) or as document URLs. Supports an optional cover page, scheduled send time, tags, and custom fields. The send endpoint exposes the same options available in the web portal.

REST API for the Documo (mFax) cloud fax and document delivery platform. The API is organized around REST, accepts form-encoded and JSON request bodies, returns JSON-encoded responses, and is secured with an API key passed in the Authorization header. Send and receive faxes, manage fax numbers, subscribe to delivery events via webhooks, and read account information.
